_meta.description: LOW-CONFIDENCE FALLBACK ONLY — keyword substring hints for individual receipt line-item names, used by receipt-parse when Haiku's own per-item categoryGuess does not cleanly map to a NAICS code via data/category_to_naics.json's plaidDetailed rows. This is NOT a primary classifier: it is a small, deliberately incomplete keyword -> NAICS crosswalk that exists only to avoid throwing away an otherwise-parseable receipt item. Any match via this file must be surfaced at 'low' confidence, same ceiling discipline as spendFactors.ts's own fallback path (NAICS 452319, see category_to_naics.json's _meta.fallback).
_meta.matchRule: case-insensitive substring match against the item name (and categoryGuess if present); first match in array order wins
_meta.codesVerifiedAgainst: every naicsCode below was checked present in data/useeio_factors.json's factor table as of this file's creation — a keyword hint that resolved to a NAICS code missing from the factor file would make findOrCreateFactorId throw at parse time, so any future addition to this list MUST be cross-checked against data/useeio_factors.json first
